name: OpenVDB to Yocto Volume Conversion
definition: A pipeline to convert OpenVDB volume data (density and temperature grids) into a Yocto-compatible volume format for rendering.
summary: OpenVDB to Yocto Volume Conversion transforms sparse OpenVDB grids into dense Yocto .vol files using yovdbload, differing from generic sparse-to-dense methods by targeting the Yocto ecosystem.
